{{Quote|The Techno Union army is at your disposal, Count.|Wat Tambor to Count Dooku|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''Techno Union Droid Army''' was owned by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] pledged the army to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which was merged into the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

==History==
[[File:Tambor_on_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|250px|Wat Tambor with his droids on Ryloth.]]
[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] devoted the organization's [[droid]] [[army]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], following suit with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and, later, other corporate businesses.<ref name="AOTC" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Emir/Legends|Emir]] Wat Tambor and his [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]] launched an [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invasion]] of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], after the discovery of treasure belonging to [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]. [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] headed the orbital defense force, while [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] was left in command of the [[Proton cannon/Legends|Proton cannons]].<ref name="TCWSOR">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref><ref name="TCWIOR">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> Nearing the end of the battle, the planetary capital, [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], was bombarded by the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and Wat Tambor was captured as his [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] left with TA-175, under orders by Count Dooku.<ref name="TCWLOR">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] [[Kul Teska]] later commanded the remaining troops in order to retrieve an essential component of the [[Gravitic polarization beam]] from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. After a confrontation with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], he fled the planet with the [[Gravitic Core]] on Bane's [[Telgorn dropship]], [[Sleight of Hand|The Sleight of Hand]].<ref name="TCWRH">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

The Techno Union base on [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]] was [[Battle of Xagobah (Clone Wars)|assaulted]] by Republic troops in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Wat Tambor and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] commanded the Techno Union Droid Army throughout the battle but the planet was liberated.<ref name="BFANT">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref><ref name="BFP">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref>

[[File:Mutantchamber.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Techno Union/Legends|B1]]-battle droids oversee the transformation chamber.]]
Wat Tambor, unhappy on the inferiority of battle droid infantry, began experimenting on new forms of infantry in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Cloning]] facilities were established on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and a Techno Union base was established on [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]] to experiment on mutation and cybernetic control devices. This Nelvaan base used a [[Siphon generator]] and churned out mutated [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanians]], with weapon systems grafted to their arms. The base and its commanding [[Techno Union scientist]] were destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

At the end of the Clone Wars, the Techno Union was dissolved and imperialized into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] along with other technology manufacturers.
